Padrão de especificação do IARA adaptado para o Sabiá: HF, REG, EL, MSG e ATA no formato da casa, a ET as-built no design.md e as linhas do CT.csv, pelos padrões do IARA e um fluxo mínimo de perguntas

IARA specification standard on top of the Sabiá flow: the iara skill writes the body of user stories (HF), business rules (REG), screen layouts (EL), messages (MSG) and meeting minutes (ATA) in the house format, the as-built technical specification (ET) in the design.md sections, and the test-case lines of CT.csv, each by the IARA pattern of the type and a minimal flow of questions; the Sabiá step brings the inputs and writes, approves and publishes.
